meta_title: Crypto payments for consultants & coaches · Dynopay
meta_description: Get paid in crypto for consulting and coaching with Dynopay. Invoice clients worldwide, no chargebacks, 15+ cryptocurrencies, fees from 1.5%. Start free.
h1: Accept crypto payments for consulting and coaching, from any client worldwide
subheading: Dynopay lets consultants, coaches, and advisors invoice clients in Bitcoin, stablecoins, and 15+ cryptocurrencies directly to a wallet they control — with instant settlement and no chargebacks.
intro_paragraph: Consultants and coaches often bill international clients, where wire transfers are slow and expensive and card chargebacks can follow a delivered engagement. Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto payment gateway that settles straight to your wallet. Send a branded payment link for a retainer, a package, or a single session, take payment on hosted checkout, or automate invoicing through the REST API across 15+ cryptocurrencies. Fees start at 1.5% and drop to 0.5% at scale, with no chargebacks, no monthly fees, and a free first payment.

features.title: Invoice global clients in seconds
features.description: Send a payment link by email or chat and get paid in minutes — no international wire, no waiting days, and no correspondent-bank fees eating your invoice.

features.title: No chargebacks after the work is delivered
features.description: Crypto payments are final, so a client can't dispute your fee through a card issuer once the sessions or deliverables are done.

features.title: Hold a stable balance
features.description: Accept USDT or USDC to keep a dollar-pegged balance and avoid volatility, then convert to your local currency whenever you choose.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, create a company profile, and add one payout wallet address for settlement.
Create a payment link for each client, retainer, or package — or embed checkout on your booking page.
The client pays in their preferred cryptocurrency and funds arrive in your wallet within minutes.

faqs.question: How do consultants and coaches get paid with Dynopay?
faqs.answer: Create a payment link for a session, package, or retainer and send it to the client, or embed checkout on your booking page. When they pay in crypto, funds settle to your wallet within minutes — no international wire delays.

faqs.question: Can I bill a monthly retainer in crypto?
faqs.answer: Yes, on a per-cycle basis. Crypto has no card auto-charge, so each renewal is a fresh payment — use the REST API and webhooks to send a payment link every billing cycle automatically.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can clients pay with?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, TRX, MATIC, and stablecoins such as USDT (ERC20, TRC20, Polygon), USDC (ERC20), and RLUSD.

faqs.question: What are the fees for accepting consulting payments?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drop to 0.5% as your settled volume grows. No setup fees, no monthly fees, and your first payment is free.

faqs.question: Is my money held by Dynopay?
faqs.answer: No. Dynopay is non-custodial, so payments settle directly to a wallet you control — MetaMask, Coinbase, Ledger, or any address you own.

cta_headline: Start invoicing clients in crypto in 10 minutes
cta_body: Sign up now and your first transaction is fee-free. No monthly costs, and funds settle straight to a wallet you control.
